Definition: Taberah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Taberah means burning, and the place got its name when the fire of the Lord burnt among the people for their complaining. Moses names it again when he lists the places where Israel provoked the Lord. It is one of the wilderness places where the people's temper met God's fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Taberah is a warning written into a place name: complaining kindled a fire once, and the name was kept so Israel would not forget it.
